title: Decrease Safety Margin
statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to come closer to obstacles, potentially increasing its speed and efficiency, but at the risk of more frequent collisions.
mechanism: The safety margin is a buffer zone that the robot maintains around obstacles to ensure safe navigation. Decreasing this margin can make the robot more aggressive in its path planning.
contradicting_evidence: Experiment plan_4d431e78: Observed delta=+1.000. Verdict: degraded (Collisions increased from 0.0 to 1.0 (+1.0).).
